acceptance.given: Stable and Candidate subjects are selected for Matrix Case execution.

oracle.expected: Execution inputs and evidence identify distinct fixtures and distinct execution state for Stable versus Candidate subjects.
oracle.observable: The replay matrix execution records expose separate fixture and state identities for Stable and Candidate.

acceptance.then: The Matrix Case run records show attributable, non-shared fixture and state identities for both subject classes.
acceptance.when: Each Matrix Case execution record is inspected after execution.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Inspect Matrix Case replay records and fail when Stable and Candidate resolve to the same fixture or execution-state identity.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure Matrix Case execution binds Stable and Candidate subjects to distinct immutable fixtures and state with attributable evidence.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve matrix schema and replay identities; revert only subject fixture/state binding changes.

slice_hint.state_transition: Matrix execution moves from potentially shared subject context to distinct Stable and Candidate fixture/state contexts.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every inspected Matrix Case records distinct Stable and Candidate fixture and state identities with attributable evidence.

acceptance.given: An otherwise valid two-subject Matrix Case has a frozen expectation or expected output altered after its binding.

oracle.expected: The aggregate evaluator detects expectation-forged evidence and returns an unsuccessful aggregate verdict.
forbidden: Forged expected output or expectation is accepted.
The aggregate succeeds despite expectation-forged Matrix evidence.
oracle.observable: The aggregate result and case diagnostic identify expectation-forged evidence as the invalidating condition.

acceptance.then: Expectation-forged Matrix evidence cannot produce aggregate success.
acceptance.when: The matrix evaluator processes frozen expectations and expected outputs for both subject executions.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run an expectation-forgery fixture through matrix aggregate evaluation and require rejection instead of aggregate success.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make the Toolchain matrix aggregate evaluator reject a Matrix Case when its expected output or expectation differs from the frozen bound expectation identity; the forged evidence invalidates the aggregate.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Adds only fail-closed aggregate rejection for expectation-forged evidence; non-forged matrix evaluation and terminal failure categories remain compatible.

slice_hint.state_transition: Matrix evidence with an unauthenticated expectation transitions to an unsuccessful aggregate result when its forged expectation is detected.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: For an otherwise valid two-subject Matrix Case with an altered bound expectation, the aggregate is unsuccessful with an expectation-forged diagnostic and never succeeds.

acceptance.given: The aggregate is evaluated while matrix evidence is stale.

oracle.expected: The aggregate is marked invalid and cannot be accepted or published.
forbidden: An aggregate remaining valid despite stale matrix evidence.
Acceptance or publication of the stale aggregate.
oracle.observable: Aggregate evaluation output contains an invalid verdict and blocks acceptance.

acceptance.then: The stale-evidence aggregate is invalid and acceptance is blocked.
acceptance.when: The aggregate evaluator processes matrix evidence whose freshness is stale.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run aggregate evaluation with stale matrix evidence and fail if the verdict remains valid or acceptance is allowed.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Invalidate aggregate evaluation when matrix evidence freshness is stale and prevent acceptance.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep aggregate and evidence schemas compatible; revert only stale-freshness invalidation logic.

slice_hint.state_transition: Aggregate transitions from evaluated-with-stale-evidence to invalid and non-acceptable.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Given stale matrix evidence, evaluator emits invalid and acceptance remains blocked.

acceptance.given: The requested operation receives a target that is wrong for the requested operation or package identity.

oracle.expected: The operation is rejected or blocked before any target-dependent action proceeds.
forbidden: Treating the wrong target as the requested target.
oracle.observable: The operation returns a rejection or blocked outcome and no target-dependent side effect or continuation is recorded.

acceptance.then: The wrong-target condition is rejected and no target-dependent operation proceeds.
acceptance.when: Target identity validation executes for the requested operation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Invoke target identity validation with a wrong target and fail if the operation proceeds, accepts, or substitutes that target.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject wrong operation or package targets before target-dependent execution and preserve fail-closed behavior.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No schema change; revert target-validation behavior while retaining existing package identity compatibility.

slice_hint.state_transition: Request transitions from wrong-target input to rejected/blocked terminal state with no target-dependent continuation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Wrong target input yields rejection or blocked outcome and no target-dependent operation executes.
